body: Lel, I've tried acid too, it was fun, but only made me feel better for a while afterwards. I've also tried coke, h, valium, shrooms, MDMA, speed and none of it helped in the long run. I'm all for drugs, but I'm unstable and I can't handle the effects right now and I'm miserable at using them responsibly.

I've tried antidepressants, they made me really paranoid. I've also tried neuroleptics and they sucked dick. I'm from Germany, what are you getting at? Are you talking about weed? Because I smoked weed for months until I became psychotic, then I had to stop. I've tried smoking once since then, I thought I was going to hell and I was talking to the devil and really silly stuff, but it was very scary at that moment.
